body:
I saved the cloth with a sweet chemical smell for you. The water-treatment trial crew passed Thursday after closing; the rats left the shed, and afterward the clinic stopped answering.

I carried it home because there was nowhere open to return it. The mark did not come off when I tried to wash my hands.

The next morning I looked for a second copy and found only the envelope. I left this one unfolded for whoever came after us.
title: Thursday after closing — a sweet chemical smell
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same a sweet chemical smell while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
